notes.title: Status Update: What is going on?!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It has been a while since I shared a last status update for Sonorous. What has been happening?
So in the recent months there have been multiple aspects:

[b]World Building[/b]
[list]
[*] It took some time but now the entire Sonorous world is blocked out and everything has its place. This was a back-and-forth process to ensure that the gameplay flow and story feel harmonious with distances in the world and providing still enough space for free roam exploration.
[/list]
[b]NPC[/b]
[list]
[*]I used a considerable amount of time to setup a core structure for my NPCs allowing me to exchange & add various characters and body types. The NPCs have combat abilities, unique animations and ragdoll effects. In advance, my aim is to allow dialogue and interactions between the NPCs making the whole world feel a lot more alive!
[/list]
[b]Environment & Assets[/b]
[list]
[*] Along with the world building, I have been working on new assets to integrate involving new sceneries and assets specific complimenting these. 
[*] Continued revision of the submarine interior.
[/list]	
[b]Deep Sea [/b]
[list]
[*]A creature has been added with unique behaviour requiring caution and thoughtful movements from the player.
[/list]

Many of these building blocks impact one another so there are multiple aspects worked on simultaneously. Even though there is still a lot to do, I feel like Sonorous is progressing nicely and is on track with my original planning! I will continue extending the world and building on the gameplay. There will be a lot of iterations to make everything as smooth and enjoyable as possible

notes.title: Performance is great and currently working on the Crafting/Building System!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

First off, I have been tweaking a lot with the overall settings and performance seems great as of now. In the past, I have also revised the steam page and worked on a new trailer.  

I have now started looking more into the crafting & building systems. Along with basic foundations, your shelter construction can now be extend to the water surface & I added some railings to prevent you from falling off. Maybe makes your shelter a bit cosier as well :)

The wall panels provide automatic variation, to prevent the tiles from repeating. Next up, I will continue with more modules and hope that the overall system will work out. 

Have a great weekend everyone!

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Unity3D/comments/17s41qt/your_shelter_construction_can_now_be_extend_to/?sort=new]Here a short video of the system.[/url]

notes.title: Revised the Underwater Aesthetics with Performance Improvements!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PXmoyPMnb1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone, I have revised the underwater aspects of "Sonorous." Here a video from a small performance test on the new underwater setup. 4k with highest quality settings running at 45-50 fps (QHD at 60fps) as of now. Quite happy with that result! GPU: RTX 3070

At the moment I am building the overall environment and blocking out the world before continuing mission development and integration of new assets and game mechanics. 

Please feel free to give your input so I can continue improve the game! Thank you for your help in advance.
